shots.lyric: Hit zoom. Zoom in, in, in, in, in, in, in, in, in to see far things big now.
shots.status: creative intent captured; onset review before final animation
shots.description: Her point of view through the spacecraft sphere. A distant dot stays centered. Each of nine sung 'in's triggers another progressive magnification, revealing a planet in a faraway stellar system. The inside of the transparent sphere acts as a telescope display: the image she appears to see through it is optically projected/magnified, as though looking directly at the distant planet. Keep a continuous viewpoint and recognizable target across all nine steps.
